• Permissions: Manage all required app permissions
• Vehicle Config: Select vehicle model to adapt camera layout
• Recording Mode: - Auto: Automatically selects optimal engine - MediaRecorder: Hardware encoder - MediaCodec: Direct codec pipeline
• Segment Duration: - 1 Min: Small files, easy to share - 3 Min: Balanced file size and continuity - 5 Min: Fewer total files
• Storage Location: - Internal: /DCIM/EVCam_Video/ - USB Drive: USB/DCIM/ (Requires permission) - Staging cache write is automatically used for USB
• Auto Cleanup: - Set storage limits for videos and photos - Checks 30s after boot and every hour - Purges oldest files when limit is reached
• Recording Status: - Displays recording timer and segment count in top-right - Double-tap to toggle visibility
• Timestamp Watermark: - Adds timestamp to saved media - MediaCodec mode only for video
• Auto-Start on Boot: Automatically runs when vehicle starts
• Auto-Start Recording: Automatically begins recording on launch
• Sentry Mode (Screen-Off Recording): - Keeps recording when vehicle screen is off/locked
• Scheduled Keep-Alive: Wakes up every 15 min to stay active
• Prevent Deep Sleep: Keeps background services alive while parked (increases 12V battery drain)
• Floating Button: Draggable overlay button to toggle recording
